**Andrew** → Brenda → Samantha → Cynthia → Kayla → Christine → William → Eugene → Carol → Daniel → Judith → Theresa → Bobby → Christian → David → Vincent → Marie → Elijah → Ethan → Martha → Joan → Jason → Catherine → Juan → Jonathan → Charlotte → Randy → Alexis → Albert → Hannah → Patrick → Donna → Melissa → Evelyn → Raymond → Kathryn → Steven → Emily → Christopher → Lawrence → Aaron → Ann → Christina → Charles → Bruce → Billy → Kathleen → Patricia → Sara → Amanda → Denise → Cheryl → Dennis → Dylan → Grace → Matthew → Alan → Sean → Gary → Ralph → Nancy → Jennifer → Betty → Philip → Gloria → Jack → Sharon → Shirley → Katherine → Austin → Kevin → Sarah → Kenneth → Henry → Jesse → Barbara → George → Helen → Justin → Samuel → Anthony → Virginia → Natalie → Debra → Diane → Brandon → Douglas → Dorothy → Carolyn → Nathan → Doris → Isabella → Zachary → Madison → Sandra → Diana → Roy → Frank → Bryan → Rebecca → Stephen → Gabriel → Joseph → Sophia → Abigail → Anna → Lauren → Megan → Keith → Emma → Angela → Michael → Paul → Pamela → Jessica → Amber → Andrea → Thomas → Jacob → Mason → **Ruth**

## Tracing Karen's Descendants

**Karen** → Ryan → Olivia → Mary → James → Donald → Gregory → Jean → Nicholas → Richard → Laura → Beverly → Roger → Ashley → Joyce → Teresa → Ronald → Frances → Carl → Lisa → Edward → Gerald → Larry → Linda → Amy → Brian → Wayne → Elizabeth → Scott → Peter → Maria → Jordan → Joe → Adam → Rachel → Arthur → Susan → Willie → Margaret → Michelle → Jeffrey → Nicole → Jose → Julie → Logan → Jeremy → Heather → Timothy → Eric → Walter → Kelly → Janice → Robert → Bradley → Judy → Brittany → Marilyn → Benjamin → Tyler → Victoria → Terry → Julia → Russell → Danielle → Janet → Lori → Stephanie → Joshua → Kimberly → Harold → Jerry → **Ruth**

Both chains converge at **Ruth** — Andrew is Ruth's ancestor (through Mason) and Karen is Ruth's ancestor (through Jerry). The two chains are otherwise completely disjoint, so neither is an ancestor of the other, and they share no common ancestor.
